name: 01 / ENTER THE LEAGUE
title: Your knowledge. A place on the podium.
subtitle: Ten questions · two minutes · free entry
narration: Flat League turns community knowledge into a short competition, with free entry and creator-funded rewards.

name: 02 / FIND YOUR ROUND
title: A game space for your community.
subtitle: A real lobby, with sample challenges removed
narration: The lobby brings rounds together. Sample challenges are removed, so this view is ready for a community's first real event.

name: 03 / CREATE A CHALLENGE
title: Bring the questions. Set the challenge.
subtitle: Creator studio · ten-question pack
narration: A host names the challenge, writes ten questions and sets the answer choices. For this recorded test, we use the public sample question pack.

name: 04 / FUND THE PRIZE POOL
title: Fund the round before anyone plays.
subtitle: 10 MockWIF · exact approval and escrow funding
narration: The host sets a schedule and deposits ten Mock WIF into escrow. The approval and funding are real transactions in this local test playground.

name: 05 / JOIN FOR FREE
title: A separate wallet. No entry tokens.
subtitle: Sponsored registration · one attempt per wallet
narration: A separate player wallet joins for free, starting with no tokens or gas. The platform sponsors registration, and the player starts one timed run.

name: 06 / TAKE YOUR RUN
title: Accuracy first. Speed breaks ties.
subtitle: Server timer · confirmed answers · scores private until closing
narration: Answer ten questions within two minutes. Confirmed answers stay locked, and refreshing does not reset the timer. The server scores the run, while standings remain private until the round closes.

name: 07 / SEE THE RESULT
title: A finished run. A confirmed reward.
subtitle: Signed settlement · fixed-recipient payout · local MockWIF
narration: After closing, the service signs the results and the contract allocates rewards. With one eligible finisher, the entire ten-token pool goes to that player. The payout is confirmed.

name: 08 / HOST THE NEXT ROUND
title: A little play. A reason to return.
subtitle: flat-league.vercel.app · github.com/greyw0rks/flat-league
narration: This recording uses local test tokens. The hosted MVP uses Robinhood Chain testnet and Mock WIF. Mainnet WIF integration is next. Bring your community to Flat League.
